name: Victor Negrescu - Après le § 7 - Am 6
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 1/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 entering the surplus of the financial year 2024
part_text: 7 a. Rejects the creation of any new own resource that would burden European taxpayers; emphasises the need to drastically reduce EU spending to alleviate the tax burden and avoid passing on an even heavier burden to future generations due to the debt created by the “Next Generation EU” loan;
